text.p: The following are key facts about Nicaragua, where Arnoldo Aleman was sworn in on Friday as President.
Geography: Nicaragua is bounded by Honduras to the north, Costa Rica to the south, the Pacific Ocean to the west and the Caribbean Sea to the east.
Language: Spanish is the official language. Some people on the Caribbean coast speak Creole English and Miskito Indians also have their own language.
Currency: The cordoba. Current exchange rate: 8.95 cordobas = US $1.
Armed forces: About 15,000 soldiers. Before 1990, the armed forces had 100,000 members.

Presidential inauguration facts: Seven presidents and delegates from 61 countries will converge in Managua's 22,000- seat Rigoberto Lopez Perez stadium to see outgoing President Violeta Chamorro pass the presidential sash to Arnoldo Aleman.
More than 2,300 Nicaraguan police will protect the ceremony and key plazas and hotels.
Aleman easily topped left-wing former Sandinista ruler Daniel Ortega 51 to 38 percent in the Oct. 20 presidential election.
